props.title: .Cinema
props.subtitle: Reimagining movie discovery, real-time auditorium seat selection, and frictionless cinema checkout for dark-room environments.

props.heading: Cinema booking is broken.
props.summary: Most cinema apps bury showtimes behind pop-up ads, force mandatory account registration before revealing available seats, and surprise moviegoers with convenience fees at payment. .Cinema streamlines the entire booking ritual — from watching IMAX trailers to scanning a live QR pass — into an effortless 2-minute dark-mode experience.

props.heading: What moviegoers struggled with
props.statement: We interviewed 16 frequent cinema visitors and observed live mobile bookings to uncover why 61% abandoned mobile checkout in favor of buying at the counter.

painPoints.title: Unreadable micro seat maps
painPoints.body: Pinch-zooming 200+ tiny seat squares caused frequent mis-taps on adjacent rows.

painPoints.title: Forced sign-up walls
painPoints.body: Users had to create a password and verify SMS before even seeing if two seats together were free.

painPoints.title: Surprise checkout fees
painPoints.body: Booking fees and 3D glasses surcharges appeared only on the final payment step.

painPoints.title: Fragmented format filters
painPoints.body: Switching between IMAX, Dolby Atmos, and VIP required restarting the movie search.

painPoints.title: Harsh white screens in halls
painPoints.body: Opening email PDFs inside dark auditoriums blinded nearby viewers and failed scanner brightness.

painPoints.title: Clunky group coordination
painPoints.body: Sharing seat numbers and splitting snack combos with friends required manual screenshots.

props.heading: Eight core booking pain points
props.statement: Mapping heuristic violations across legacy cinema apps gave us eight measurable UX targets.

painPoints.title: Too many taps
painPoints.body: Average legacy flow took 11 screens from launch to confirmed ticket.

painPoints.title: Zero acoustic guidance
painPoints.body: First-time visitors had no hint which rows offered optimal screen angle and sound.

painPoints.title: Slow snack upsells
painPoints.body: Mandatory multi-page concession menus interrupted urgent last-minute bookings.

painPoints.title: Manual card entry
painPoints.body: Missing one-tap Apple Pay and Google Pay caused 34% payment drop-off.

painPoints.title: Lost PDF tickets
painPoints.body: Users hunted through inbox attachments at the turnstile queue.

painPoints.title: Stale seat locks
painPoints.body: Seats appeared open until checkout failed with an expired session error.

painPoints.title: Weak trailer context
painPoints.body: Users bounced to YouTube and IMDb to check ratings before returning to book.

painPoints.title: Rigid cancellations
painPoints.body: Swapping showtimes required calling customer support instead of one-tap self-service.

props.heading: Six product pillars
props.subtitle: Design principles translating user research directly into interface mechanics.

steps.title: Seats Before Sign-In
steps.body: Let moviegoers inspect real-time auditorium availability before asking for identity.

steps.title: Dark-Room Ergonomics
steps.body: True obsidian surfaces with calibrated crimson accents protect night vision inside halls.

steps.title: Thumb-Zone Controls
steps.body: Date pills, seat confirmation, and Pay CTAs sit comfortably within one-handed reach.

steps.title: Honest All-In Pricing
steps.body: Running ticket + combo totals update live on every tap with zero hidden checkout fees.

steps.title: Smart Pair Selection
steps.body: Selecting 2 guests highlights contiguous center pairs automatically.

steps.title: Gate-Ready Pass
steps.body: High-contrast QR code auto-boosts only inside the QR square for instant turnstile scans.

props.heading: Structure before style
props.subtitle: Low-fidelity architecture validated tap targets, information density, and flow speed with 8 test users before applying visual polish.

props.heading: Typography & color tokens
props.body: Built around geometric Plus Jakarta Sans display headlines, ultra-legible Inter UI labels, and a high-contrast cinema crimson + obsidian dark token scale.

props.heading: Crafted for dark-room clarity
props.subtitle: Ten core screens spanning onboarding, discovery, showtime filtering, interactive seat selection, snack combos, Apple Pay checkout, and live QR pass.

props.heading: Interactive auditorium seat map
props.body: The seat picker was redesigned from the ground up as a tactile, zero-pinch canvas that guides moviegoers to the best acoustic view in seconds.

bullets.text: Curved laser screen arc establishes immediate spatial orientation
Three-state high-contrast seat tokens: White open, Crimson selected, Charcoal reserved
Center acoustic sweet-spot indicator boosts VIP conversion without dark patterns

takeaways.title: 01 · Context beats decoration
takeaways.body: Designing specifically for dim theater lighting made contrast hierarchy and thumb reach far more impactful than heavy visual chrome.

takeaways.title: 02 · Defer authentication
takeaways.body: Letting users explore live seats first built immediate commitment before biometric checkout.

takeaways.title: 03 · Systemize early
takeaways.body: Defining semantic status tokens upfront kept seat states, snack badges, and wallet passes unmistakably consistent.
